items.text: France 24 reported that Zelensky said Ukraine sank a Russian naval corvette in a Libyan port on Sunday in an attack involving seven naval drones.
Al Jazeera reported at least 15 killed in Ukraine’s Kyiv region amid intensified Russian attacks; the event time was not stated.
BBC News World reported that Finnish defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind a drone strike on a Russia-bound ship in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday; Kyiv had yet to comment.
France 24 reported that drone strikes damaged homes and a United Nations building in Khartoum early Sunday, and that Sudan’s army accused neighbouring Ethiopia of launching them.
